title: Bel Sarbat
description: Bel Sarbat (Bael Fruit Syrup) is a highly therapeutic and cooling syrup made from the pulp of the sacred Bael fruit (Aegle marmelos). This classical formulation is the ultimate remedy for hot summer. Tones the intestines. Treats chronic diarrhea. Treats dysentery. Cures heat-induced constipation.
dosage: 30–50 ml mixed well in a glass of water, consumed once or twice a day
